title: Try it
text: Paste Shinylive editor (install shinyglass GitHub editor CRAN build older 0.3.0): app lives inst/examples/playground.R source repository.
code: library(shiny) library(shinyglass)  ui <- glass_page(   title = "shinyglass playground",   persist = TRUE,   scene = "tahoe",   sliderInput("n", "Points", 10, 80, 30),   plotOutput("p", height = "280px") )  server <- function(input, output, session) {   observe_glass(input, session)   output$p <- renderPlot({     pal <- glass_plot_colors(input = input)     plot(       seq_len(input$n),       sin(seq_len(input$n) / 4),       col = pal$fill,       pch = 16,       fg = pal$ink,       col.axis = pal$ink     )   }, bg = "transparent") }  shinyApp(ui, server)

text: Bootstrap’s color-contrast() often picks black ink system blue #007AFF. glass_theme() forces light ink primary fills checked checkboxes, radios, switches, active pagination retain light ink. White #007AFF approximately 4.02:1: meets 3:1 large-text threshold, 4.5:1 ordinary-text threshold. Choose test appropriate darker accent ordinary white labels must meet threshold. title: Liquid Glass theme for 'shiny' — glass_theme
text: preset "light", "dark", "auto". "auto" follows prefers-color-scheme updates OS theme changes. primary Accent color buttons, links, focus rings. Defaults system blue (#007AFF). blur Backdrop blur radius pixels. Default 36 matches iOS 27 diffusion-first material. saturation Backdrop saturation percentage. radius Default border radius glass surfaces (CSS length). Prefer larger concentric radii (default 1.5rem). material "regular" (adaptive, UI) "clear" (transparent; best media-rich content bold labels). intensity Liquid Glass intensity 0 (Ultra Clear) 1 (Tinted), matching iOS 27 Appearance -> Liquid Glass. Default 0.45. Use glass_intensity_slider() live control. tint Content-aware ambient tint plots/images (JS). specular Pointer-driven specular highlight glass surfaces (JS). nav_morph Compact navbar scroll ; expand scroll (JS). ambient_motion Animate decorative ambient sheen. Set FALSE keep static glass surfaces. OS reduced-motion settings take priority. persist Remember preset, intensity, accent, material, scene localStorage app path. Default FALSE (opt ). glass_page() turns . scene Wallpaper scene: "default", "tahoe", "dusk", "mesh". wallpaper Optional image URL painted frosted photo behind glass (https, data URI, site-relative path). ... Additional arguments forwarded bslib::bs_theme().

Enable disable content-aware ambient tint. primary Optional accent color (hex like "#AF52DE" rgb()). intensity Optional numeric \([0, 1]\): Ultra Clear (0) Tinted (1). material Optional "regular" "clear". ambient_motion Optional logical. scene Optional "default", "tahoe", "dusk", "mesh".

title: Update glass theme options in a running app — update_glass_theme
text: primary updates CSS variables (--bs-primary, --bs-primary-rgb, --glass-primary) buttons, checks, accent surfaces follow new color. Sass-baked one-colors may switch full reload. intensity updates fill/blur along Ultra Clear Tinted spectrum (see glass_intensity_slider()).

title: Update glass theme options in a running app — update_glass_theme
code: if (interactive()) {   library(shiny)   library(shinyglass)    ui <- fluidPage(     theme = glass_theme(),     glass_theme_toggle(),     selectInput("accent", "Accent", c("#007AFF", "#AF52DE", "#FF9500"))   )    server <- function(input, output, session) {     observe_glass_theme_toggle(input, session)     observeEvent(input$accent, {       update_glass_theme(session, primary = input$accent)     }, ignoreInit = TRUE)   }    shinyApp(ui, server) }

text: Light dark glass surfaces now dual CSS custom-property packs [data-glass-preset]. Switching preset longer requires recompiling Sass reloading page. title: shinyglass 0.2.0
text: Light / Dark / Auto iOS-style segmented control: theme-aware glass thumb (changes light vs dark), body ink every chip, delegated click Auto applies even host pages rewrite inline handlers. Theme toggle applies preset (inline handler + server echo storm), plots longer flicker switching Light / Dark. Default actionButton() / .btn-link ink follows theme tokens (--glass-body-color / --glass-accent) instead compiled $primary. [glass_resolved_preset()] reports resolved light/dark appearance plots stay light-inked user picks Auto. Dark pack longer re-locks default / outline / download labels compiled $primary. Download links ghost focus rings follow --glass-accent. Accent <select id="accent"> applies setPrimary immediately. [glass_intensity_slider()] / [observe_glass_intensity()] — iOS 27-style Ultra Clear → Tinted control. glass_theme(intensity = ) sets starting value (0–1, default 0.45); [update_glass_theme()] window.shinyglass.setIntensity() update live. [glass_preset_input()] / [observe_glass_preset_input()] — client-first Light/Dark/Auto select (applies setPreset immediately; server sync optional). Prefer bare selectInput() + update_glass_theme() alone hosts rewrite custom messages. Theme delivery dual-channel (shinyglass + legacy glassPreset) self-healing oncustommessage proxy preset/intensity/showModal survive host message rewrites (e.g. shinyapps.io). Demo app intensity-slider-demo.R; live shinyglass-demo shinyglass-dashboard ship glass_intensity_slider() UI. iOS 27 material polish: stronger darkened edges, brighter specular highlights, intensity-scaled fill/blur clearer layer separation readability. Dark-mode nav tab ink keeps WCAG UI 3:1 glass (inactive tabs). Closer iOS 27 Liquid Glass: defined borders (shadow-), chromatic edge refraction cues, lighter dark-mode glass, thicker elevated chrome, ambient specular drift + pointer override, stronger diffusion blur defaults (blur = 36, saturation = 200). Runtime light/dark switching via document.documentElement.dataset.glassPreset without full reload. glass_theme(preset = "auto") follows prefers-color-scheme updates OS theme changes. [update_glass_theme()] change preset, tint, primary (live accent via --glass-accent / --bs-primary) server. Recolors primary buttons, Shiny checkboxInput() / radios / switches, ion.rangeSlider bars, value chips, active nav/list items without Sass recompile. [glass_theme_toggle()] / [observe_glass_theme_toggle()] drop-Light / Dark / Auto buttons. Behavior knobs [glass_theme()]: tint, specular, nav_morph (default TRUE, matching 0.1.x JS behavior). Client helpers: window.shinyglass.setPreset() / .getPreset() / .setTint() / .setPrimary() / .getPrimary().

title: shinyglass 0.2.0
text: Liquid Glass material fidelity (Tahoe / iOS 26 inspired): multi-layer surfaces (illumination fill, dual-edge rim/lip, ambient + pointer specular), chrome vs content hierarchy (less glass--glass), softer wallpaper orbs, larger concentric radii, capsule-leaning controls. New glass_theme(material = "regular"|"clear"). Clear transparent media-rich layouts. Defaults: blur = 36, radius = "1.5rem", saturation = 200. Value boxes tinted glass (theme-color wash + body ink), solid .bg-* slabs. Plots DT/gt hosts inside cards drop extra glass frame page orbs show (renderPlot(bg = "transparent") bundled demos). DataTables / Bootstrap pagination chips: style visible .page-link surface (DT uses <li.paginate_button><.page-link>). Fixes solid black page numbers light-grey ellipsis chips dark mode dashboard demo / README screenshots. Overlay chrome (datepicker popup, Shiny notification types, generic accordion, Bootstrap tooltip/popover/toast, .btn-close, file Browse chip) now uses glass menu pack dark mode leftover Bootstrap light hex. Datepicker hoisted document.body (Shiny 1.14 bsDatepicker) card/navbar backdrop-filter longer clips calendar. Navbar overflow visible nav_menu dropdowns escape glass bar. Kitchen-sink example: chrome-kitchen-sink.R (page_navbar, nav_menu, showModal(), four showNotification() types). Visual QA harness: inst/scripts/audit-glass-contrast.R (+ .js) runs dual-theme computed-style audit (low contrast, solid-black chips, Bootstrap light greys dark, dark ink accent, DT pagination structure) across demo / dashboard / inputs-gallery / chrome kitchen-sink. Opens datepicker, navbar menu, notifications, accordion, tooltip/popover, server modal sampling. Checklist definition done inst/scripts/VISUAL-QA.md. Selectize fields: force body/menu ink inputs multi-select tags (selectize default near-black item text failed dark mode); opaque --glass-menu-bg fills dark; dropdown options use menu colors. Ecosystem chrome: plotly modebar + frame, gt tables, waiter / shinybusy overlays, shinyalert/SweetAlert2 popups, denser shinydashboardPlus controlbar/dropdowns/user menu, light rhandsontable / echarts/highcharter hosts. Examples: plotly-gt-demo.R, shinydashboardPlus-glass-demo.R. Live demo shinyglass-plotly-gt; README light/dark screenshots plotly+gt. CI workflow visual-qa (testthat + dual-theme contrast audit) committed inst/scripts/audit-baseline.json. Navbar brand / page title ink uses --glass-body-color (white brand light glass). Plotly hosts longer clip x-axis titles. Active--accent contrast: lower Bootstrap $min-contrast-ratio 3 color-contrast() picks white brand blues/purples (white #007AFF ~4.02:1 failed old 4.5 gate). Solid .bg-* / .text-bg-* fills (including bslib::value_box(theme=)) get luminance-based ink via glass-() / --glass--* — body color solid primary. Safety nets remain checks, radios, switches, pagination, list-group active. Accent rules target Shiny markup (.shiny-input-checkbox) well Bootstrap .form-check-input. Plot / image outputs get softer glass frame (lighter nesting inside cards). prefers-reduced-motion: reduce disables nav morph, specular, tint sampling, decorative transitions (JS + CSS). Demo bslib dashboard examples: theme toggle helper; dashboard accent select calls update_glass_theme(primary = …). Vignettes cover migration, primary updates, toggle helper, reduced motion. Unit tests cover dual CSS packs, head script knobs, active-color vars, update_glass_theme() messaging.
